message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine TEMPO features a pale green background with several textual and graphic elements. At the top, the large word "TEMPO" is centered in a serif font. Above it, text reads "INTERVENSI ISTANA DI GOLKAR" and "SKANDAL HARLEY BOS GARUDA." Below the title, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears.

The main image shows a light green, translucent dome-like structure being lifted by a small human figure wearing a white shirt and black pants. Inside the dome, a thin, leafless sapling grows from a yellow ground. Falling from the upper right are numerous US dollar banknotes of various sizes. One banknote is inside the dome, another lies on the ground outside.

To the right, large black text states "OUTLOOK EKONOMI 2020 PELUANG DI TENGAH ANCAMAN," with smaller text below: "MESKI DUNIA DIHANTUI RESESI, ADA CELAH AGAR INDONESIA SELAMAT." The bottom right corner contains a barcode and publication details: "9-15 DESEMBER 2019," "RP 45.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273." A vertical red band borders the left side.
